ValidationRule.description: Require Subject Specialisms for certain Teaching Roles: Originally for Client Contacts: https://1218globaluk.eu.teamwork.com/app/tasks/36131938 Then extended out to Candidates as well https://1218globaluk.eu.teamwork.com/app/tasks/36171306
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_System_Automation), ISBLANK(Subject_Specialisms__c), OR( INCLUDES(Roles__c, "Head of Subject/ Department"), INCLUDES(Roles__c, "Overseas Secondary Teacher"), INCLUDES(Roles__c, "Secondary Teacher"), INCLUDES(Roles__c, "FE Lecturer/Teacher (Further Education)"), INCLUDES(Roles__c, "HE Lecturer (Higher Education)"), INCLUDES(Roles__c, "Deputy Headteacher"), INCLUDES(Roles__c, "Assistant Headteacher") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must add a Subject Specialism if Roles contains: Secondary Teacher, Overseas Secondary Teacher, Head of Subject/Department, HE/FE Lecturer, Deputy Headteacher, or Assistant Headteacher.
